name: sheet
useFor: Use for editing or reading something beside the page without losing it (a site's requirements, a parcel's details). Side sheets are 384px wide; top and bottom sheets take their content's height. A sheet taller than the screen fades at an edge (fade-y) where more content scrolls past it.
constraints: A sheet for a quick confirmation (use Alert Dialog)
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dialog's panel and close key
title: Sheet
description: A Bone panel flush with an edge of the screen, square, with a 1px Stone line on its inner edge and no shadow, on the page under Forest at 40 percent; it slides on the drawer curve.
